subject: Follow-up: DPA + SCC module preference and SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@brightpointhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: DPA + SCC module preference and SOC2 evidence

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

Call highlights
- BrightPoint is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization features (PHI in-scope).
- Primary asks: SOC 2 report availability, preferred DPA/SCC modules, and completion of vendor security questionnaire.

Proposed next steps
1) We (Redwood) will share a draft DPA and the SCC annex recommendation (attached).
2) BrightPoint to confirm whether you want Module A (Controller-to-Processor) or Module B (Processor-to-Processor) for SCCs — based on your legal guidance.
3) BrightPoint to return the attached security questionnaire (or tell us preferred format).
4) Legal signoff: loop in Redwood Legal (cc'd) for any redlines; we can run DocuSign once DPA is agreed.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf, SCC_Annex_ModuleB.docx (note: we included Module B as our recommended starting point for joint processing of pseudonymized logs).

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute alignment with our legal/engineering to confirm the SCC module and evidence list — propose Friday 10am PT.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@brightpointhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightpointhealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: DPA + SCC module preference and SOC2 evidence

Thanks Vanessa — great recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: we typically require a SOC 2 Type II report for vendors processing PHI-adjacent data; our security ops team confirmed you can provide either a recent report or an SOC 2 bridge letter. Please send what you have (PDF).
- DPA / SCC: BrightPoint is the Controller for patient data; Redwood will be Processor. For SCCs, our legal prefers Module A when the vendor is purely a processor to the controller. That said, we will confirm with Legal and reply by end of day tomorrow.
- Questionnaire: attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire. Can you have your security/ops team complete the XLSX and return within 5 business days? If you need an alternate intake (one-pager or a call), let us know.

I'll loop in procurement if anything material changes.

Sara Thomas
Head of Security & Compliance | BrightPoint Health
sara.thomas@brightpointhealth.com
[attachment: Brightpoint_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@brightpointhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: DPA + SCC module preference and SOC2 evidence

Hi Sara / Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear notes, Sara. A couple of clarifications from Redwood Legal: 

1) Controller/Processor: Agree BrightPoint will be Controller; Redwood will act as Processor for the feature discussed. We'll keep the DPA language scoped to processing instructions and security measures; no subprocessing beyond our established list without consent.

2) SCC module: Module A (Controller-to-Processor) is the correct fit if BrightPoint remains Controller and Redwood remains Processor. We can attach Module A as an exhibit to the DPA; I note Vanessa attached Module B as an alternative — we'll switch the annex to Module A per Sara's note.

3) SOC 2 evidence: Redwood can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a summary control matrix. I will share the redacted SOC 2 PDF with you under NDA (DocuSign link available).

4) Questionnaire: Our security team (cc Priyom) will take the XLSX and aim to return within 3 business days. Priyom — can you own the questionnaire and gather the SOC 2 artifact?

Next steps / action owners
- Priyom: complete BrightPoint questionnaire and upload SOC 2 PDF (3 business days).
- Vanessa: coordinate DocuSign and procurement touchpoints once DPA is ready.
- Sara: confirm Module A from your legal team (EOD tomorrow ideally).

I can be available for a brief call if you want to walk legal through the DPA language.

Regards,
David Kim
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
[attachment: none]

- I'll intake the BrightPoint_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx and return a completed copy by Tue 24 Aug (3 business days).

- If BrightPoint confirms Module A, we'll swap the SCC annex and include it in the DocuSign packet.

Scheduling: Vanessa, if we want to walk procurement/legal through the packet, I'm available Fri 10am PT (per Vanessa's suggestion) or Mon 8/23 between 9–11am PT. Sara, any preference? I've added a tentative 20-min slot for Friday and will remove if you prefer Monday.
